content:
Tejas: Heads up — we're planning to flip v2 default for /generate in canary tomorrow. Need compatibility checklist and consent from SDKs/docs. /cc @Maya Chen @Sophie - Platform PM

Maya Chen: Which breaking changes should we expect? I'm mostly concerned about streaming payload shape and the 'model' -> 'variant' rename.

Liam (eng): Streaming is the main one. v1 used chunked events: {delta, done}. v2 changes to {type: 'delta'|'final', token: ...} — that's breaking. We can add a 'legacy_stream' query param to opt-in, or make server send both formats? Thoughts?

Sophie - Platform PM: Prefer not to double-send tokens. Suggest a semantic 'compat' header clients can opt into: `Accept: application/vnd.redwood.v1+json` fallback logic server-side. Console should surface deprecation banners + help doc quick links.

Elise (docs): I'll add migration guide if we decide header approach. Also need to update SDKs to set header by default until SDK major bump. Docs page: /docs/api/v2-migration

Tejas: Header + server fallback seems clean. We need telemetry to capture who is still using v1 shapes so we can plan a deprecation window. @deploy-bot can we log metric `api.v1_compat_used`?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled-metric-hook registered: metric=api.v1_compat_used namespace=infra.streaming. Canary rollout starts 2024-06-22T09:00Z.

Liam (eng): Telemetry: include route, sdk_user_agent, sampling=1% by default; we don't want to PII. Also record payload_shape='stream_v1'|'stream_v2' for counts. I'll add a small tracer.

Maya Chen: Quotas question: if v2 tightens token accounting (we improved prefix caching), will customers see higher token usage? Need to present comparison in console + opt-in toggles.

Sophie - Platform PM: Action items: (1) implement Accept header handling + compat flag, (2) add telemetry metric + sampling, (3) docs + SDK patch, (4) console deprecation banner with 'opt into v2' toggle and per-route diff. Target: 3-week migration window post-canary. Agree?

Tejas: :thumbsup: Agree. I'll create the PR for server changes. Liam, can you do CANARY->STAGING pipeline and add rollout policy with auto-rollback on elevated 5xx or latency p90 > baseline*1.25?

Liam (eng): Yep. I'll add fallback: if >2% 5xx in canary vs baseline we abort. Also adding a dashboard panel for 'v1_compat_used' and 'stream_errors' under Redwood / API routes.

Elise (docs): I'll draft the migration doc and a short changelog blurb for the release notes. Ping me once PR is merged.

Tejas: Cool. One more: SDKs should default to v1 header for one release, then flip after two SDK releases. We'll track installs via UA.
